sql:
SELECT a.element, m.label 
FROM atom a 
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR060'
GROUP BY a.element, m.label
